description: Cross-language contract fixture for the host-written scheduled-task strings the tasks page and IM notices translate. The backend writes these values to scheduled_task_runs.error and scheduled_tasks.last_error during goal and stop finalization and host-side run bookkeeping; the frontend (core/scheduled-tasks/goal-outcome.ts) and the IM notice renderer map them to readable text, so neither shows the raw value.
agent_stop_last_error_prefix: stopped by the agent in run
auto_pause_last_error: paused after 3 unmet scheduled goal runs

host_run_errors.restarted: interrupted: gateway restarted before the run reached a terminal state
host_run_errors.lease_lost: interrupted: the owning gateway stopped renewing its run lease
host_run_errors.queue_timeout: scheduled task queue wait timeout exceeded
host_run_errors.paused_while_queued: scheduled task was paused while queued
host_run_errors.deleted_while_queued: scheduled task was deleted while queued
